entities.summary: Katherine Olivia Sessions was an American botanist, horticulturalist, and landscape architect closely associated with San Diego, California. She is known as the "Mother of Balboa Park". Katherine Olivia Sessions was a architects & engineers from San Francisco (1857-11-08, San Francisco–1940-03-24).
